GT_CENTER controls include the correct query-coordinate prior. Positive IoU delta alone cannot establish causal contribution of auxiliary pixel content. That stronger claim needs a same-coordinate auxiliary-content control; this source review does not mandate a new experiment or implementation.

Protocol language currently confines GT controls to executor/region diagnosis, not deployed action, true trajectory upper bound, PR/NPR/SR, or latency. A positive GT-centred result is conditional opportunity evidence, not a global optimum or method contribution proof.

CPU_ANALYSIS_PASS is a numerical-integrity gate only. The later owner still must inspect the actual completed diagnostics before a scientific continuation decision, including the protocol condition to inspect the executor/region scale if GT-centred controls show no benefit.

Coverage fields are accepted native measurements, not independently recomputed from raw query geometry by this analyzer. One random control per visited state and equal token counts do not establish system latency.
